THE PROBLEM BUYERS FACE

COMMODITY BUYING SHOULDN'T FEEL LIKE CHASING PROMISES.

A buyer needs a supplier who answers clearly, checks the specification, explains the available route, and stays responsible after the quotation is sent. Too often, none of those things happen.

When supply is tight, quotes can carry a premium that has more to do with a supplier's own access than with the material. Generic grade lists replace real origin, lead-time, and packing information. And too often the follow-up ends the moment a price is sent.

WHO BUYS BITUMEN

ONE MATERIAL. EVERY SURFACE THAT HAS TO LAST.
Roads & highways

The largest use by far — penetration and viscosity grades bind the asphalt for every road, motorway and heavy-duty pavement.

Airports & ports

Runways, taxiways, aprons and container-terminal pavement that has to take concentrated loads without rutting.

Roofing & waterproofing

Oxidized bitumen in roofing felt, torch-on membranes and foundation coatings — keeping water out of buildings.

Asphalt plants

Hot-mix producers who need a consistent binder, on schedule, for binder courses and wearing courses.

Pipe & marine coatings

Corrosion protection for buried steel pipe, tanks and marine structures under constant weathering.

Road maintenance

Bitumen emulsion keeps existing networks alive without a hot-mix plant — tack coat, prime coat, slurry seal, cold patch.

HOW TO ORDER

FROM RFQ TO DELIVERED CARGO, IN FIVE STEPS.

Typical first response: one business day.

Request a Quote
Procurement Guide

STEP 01

Send your RFQ

Tell us the requirement in one message and we reply with the realistic supply path — not just a number.

Confirm the grade and technical standard — 60/70, VG, PMB, oxidized, or emulsion.
State quantity, monthly volume, and the delivery window.
Name the destination port and the Incoterm you want to buy on.
Attach any tender or project specification documents.

STEP 02

Grade & packing qualified

We match the grade to your specification and the packing to what your site can actually receive.

Grade suitability checked against your application and standard.
Packing chosen: steel drums, jumbo bags, bitutainers, flexitank, or bulk.
Route and vessel type assessed for the packing format.
Alternative grades offered where the requirement is tight.

STEP 03

Commercial terms & payment agreed

Price, Incoterm and payment instrument go into the sale contract before anything is finalised.

FOB, CFR or CIF quoted against your port and volume.
Payment by telegraphic transfer (T/T) or irrevocable letter of credit (L/C).
Advance and balance schedule written into the contract.
No trial or sample lots — every order is a genuine transaction.

STEP 04

Inspection, shipping & documents

The cargo moves with a full export document set, and independent inspection whenever it is called for.

Vessel and route booked to the agreed schedule.
COA, PDS, SDS, certificate of origin, packing list and bill of lading issued.
Independent pre-shipment inspection (e.g. SGS) arranged on request or per contract.
Shipment milestones shared with your team as they happen.
INDEPENDENT SGS-STANDARD INSPECTION AT LOAD PORT WHENEVER A BUYER OR CONTRACT CALLS FOR IT.

STEP 05

Delivery & follow-up

We stay reachable after the ship sails — a first RFQ should become a dependable, repeatable channel.

Arrival and discharge coordination with your team.
Documents couriered or released per the agreed terms.
Post-delivery review of what to improve on the next shipment.
Repeat-supply schedule set up when you want one.

BEFORE YOU CONFIRM

Before the order is confirmed

Grade suitability, packing, route, documentation, and commercial terms are all agreed in writing first. Nothing on this site is an offer — every sale is made under a separate written contract.

Request a Quote

PAYMENT TERMS

T/T — telegraphic transfer

L/C — letter of credit

No trial or sample lots are offered.

FEATURED TECHNICAL GRADE

BITUMEN 60/70

PetroBind's featured bitumen grade for general road construction and asphalt concrete production, with balanced penetration, ductility, adhesion, and waterproofing performance. PetroBind offers this grade as a principal trader and supplier, with availability confirmed against quantity, destination, packing method, and logistics window.

Penetration range: 60-70 dmm at 25 C

Typical softening point: 49-56 C

Strong adhesion to mineral aggregates

Good durability and resistance to aging

Designed for hot mix asphalt and paving applications

COA and PDS support available with recognized ASTM and ISO test methods
